reason: I already have a spreadsheet that works, and the AI draft feature makes me nervous because I would need to check every claim before sending it. I like controlling my data, but self-hosting plus possible API costs is too much to switch for an offer without a hosted option or clear setup effort.
objection: How can I trust the resume draft not to add skills or experience I never had, and what will setup and API usage actually cost me?
would_change_my_mind: A short demo proving the draft only uses facts I provide, together with a clear setup and cost estimate and an easy way to keep using my own spreadsheet.
